book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Lilobhe panane jha Yecho jwabhambitwe panchalaba
Makalongo bhango, nenga pahikita kwino nikatumii jhe malobhe makolongwa na malango gha bhando kutangacha chile jha Chapanga.
Nhwalo panikibha na mangota nikapahijhe kumanya chochoha nga Yecho Kilichitu kanjika, jhola jwabhambitwe panchalaba.
Panikibha kwino nikibha leghele, nikalendime kwa kujhoghopa hake.
Mabholo ghango na matangacho ghango nongila jhe kwa malobhe gha kuhutila bhando bhina malango, nambo ghakibha na likakala lya Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Ndehila naha nipala kihobholelo chino kikotoka kubhehe jhe mu malango gha bhando nambo itame mu makakala gha Chapanga.

Nambo tutangacha malobhe gha malango kwa bhala bhubhakomii muhuke, nambo malango ghanga chi gha pamba pannema, hilu chi gha malango gha ilongoche bha nnema ghongo bhubhabhii mu lilongo lya kuhobhelela.
Tutangacha malango gha Chapanga ghighaihitwe, Chapanga akahagwii kabula jha nnema kupanganwa kwa nhwalo gwa ung'alicho gwito.
Bhabhijhe akakolongwa bha nnema ghongo bhubhamanya malango ghanga. Ngaumanya bhakoto kummamba pa nchalaba Bhambo jwa ung'alicho.
Nambo ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: “Mambu ghala liho inahwaijhe kulola, na lichikilo inawahijhe kujhoha,
mambu gha bhando ahwachite jhe mu mwojho,
gheniya ndi Chapanga aghabhekite kwa bhala bhubhampahile.”

content: Gheniya ndi mambu Chapanga akatujhogholile kwa ndela jha Uhuke gwa Chapanga. Nhwalo Uhuke gwa Chapanga alingukiya kila kilebhe ade mambu gha nkate jha Chapanga.
Ghane jwahotola kumanya mambu gha nkate jha mundo nga uhuke gwake mundo jwenio? Helahela abhii jhe jwamanya mambu gha Chapanga nga Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Bhahe, twenga tupokiijhe uhuke gwa nnema, nambo tupokii Uhuke ghuhumita kwa Chapanga kupala kumanya ghala ghatupekei jhajhe Chapanga.

Bhahe, twenga tubhola chi kwa malobhe kwa malango gha bhando bhahoto kubhola, nambo tulonge panane jha mambu ghanga kwa malobhe gha Uhuke gwa Chapanga ibhola, tuchimulila ilebhe ya Kihuke gwa Chapanga kwa bhando bhubhabhii na Kihuke.

Mundo jwangabhehe na Uhuke gwa Chapanga ahoto jhe kughamanya mambu ghala ghighahumita kwa Chapanga, nhwalo ghibhonekana undindima kwa jwenio na amanyita jhe, nhwalo ghamanyikina kwa kutangatilwa na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nambo mundo jwakwete Uhuke gwa Chapanga, ahoto kughamanya ghoha, na abhii jhe jhonge jwahoto kunhadabhula.
Nambo twenga tuwacha ngita Kilichitu chiihwacha.
